ideas.pitch: An AI-powered system that uses smartphone camera feeds and edge computer vision to automatically detect, classify, and map urban road hazards like potholes and open manholes, syncing directly to municipal maintenance dashboards.
ideas.title: UrbanShield AI: Real-Time Pothole and Hazard Mapping for Smart Cities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Smart Cities & Urban Innovation track, giving municipal judges an actionable tool for local infrastructure management with clear economic and public safety benefits.

ideas.pitch: An IoT dashboard that monitors localized transformer temperature, oil levels, and electrical load anomalies in real-time, using predictive threshold alerts to prevent neighborhood blackouts before they happen.
ideas.title: GridWatch: IoT-Based Transformer Health and Load Monitoring System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware-centric Internet of Things data with predictive alerting, addressing real-world power distribution problems relevant to Indian urban and suburban energy grids.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension and mobile keyboard overlay that cross-references newly encountered URLs and UPI handles against live threat feeds and heuristic domain-squatting checks to prevent financial fraud.
ideas.title: PhishGuard: Localized Phishing and Fake UPI Link Detection Extension
ideas.why_it_could_win: Captures the Cybersecurity track by addressing UPI and digital payment fraud, a massively relevant consumer threat in India that immediately resonates with offline judging panels.

ideas.pitch: A vernacular multilingual mobile application that lets farmers upload leaf photos for instant disease identification using fine-tuned vision models, paired with hyper-local weather and soil condition recommendations.
ideas.title: AgriVision AI: Crop Disease and Soil Health Intelligence for Local Farmers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning with localized accessibility (vernacular support), targeting high-impact agricultural use cases that appeal strongly to regional hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: An augmented reality web-app built specifically for the IPEC campus that overlays directional arrows, lab locations, and event schedules directly onto the user's smartphone camera view for incoming freshers and hackathon visitors.
ideas.title: CampusAR: Immersive AR Indoor Navigation and Event Finder for IPEC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the AR/VR & Immersive Technologies track by building a practical, context-aware application tailored directly to the host college venue, making the demo instantly relatable to judges walking the floor.
